<script>
                                                var currentBackground = 0, bg1 = '',bg2 = '' , backgrounds = [];
backgrounds[0] = 'https://cdn.vadiro.com/vadiro/img/search/top-bg-18.jpg';backgrounds[1] = 'https://cdn.vadiro.com/vadiro/img/search/top-bg-14.jpg';backgrounds[2] = 'https://cdn.vadiro.com/vadiro/img/search/top-bg-13.jpg';backgrounds[3] = 'https://cdn.vadiro.com/vadiro/img/search/top-bg-19.jpg';backgrounds[4] = 'https://cdn.vadiro.com/vadiro/img/search/top-bg-16.jpg';backgrounds[5] = 'https://cdn.vadiro.com/vadiro/img/search/top-bg-15.jpg';backgrounds[6] = 'https://cdn.vadiro.com/vadiro/img/search/top-bg-17.jpg';backgrounds[7] = 'https://cdn.vadiro.com/vadiro/img/search/top-bg-20.jpg';                                                bg1 = backgrounds[0];
                                                //console.log('image set to-> https://cdn.vadiro.com/vadiro/img/search/top-bg-18.jpg' + ' ('+jQuery.now()+ ')');
                                                function changeBackground() {
                                                    currentBackground++;
                                                    if (currentBackground >= 8) currentBackground = 0;
                                                    bg2 = bg1;bg1 = backgrounds[currentBackground];
                                                    //console.log(bg1+'; image changed to -> ' +bg2+ ' ('+jQuery.now()+ ')');
                                                    $('#advance-search-section').css({ 'background-image': "url('" + bg1 + "')" });
                                                    $('.advance-search-section').css({ 'background-image': "url('" + bg2 + "')",
                                                        //'-webkit-transition': 'background-image 3s ease-in',
                                                        //'-moz-transition': 'background-image 3s ease-in',
                                                        //'-ms-transition': 'background-image 3s ease-in',
                                                        //'-o-transition': 'background-image 3s ease-in',
                                                        'transition': 'background-image 3s ease-in' });
                                                    setTimeout(changeBackground, 30000);
                                                }
                                                $(document).ready(function () {
                                                    //$('.advance-search-section').css({
                                                    //    'background-image': "url('" + backgrounds[0] + "')"
                                                    //});
                                                    changeBackground();
                                                    //setTimeout(changeBackground, 10000);
                                                });
    </script>
